targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(page_hits), 0) AS page_views_today FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT count(DISTINCT ip_hash) AS unique_ips_today FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT count(DISTINCT token_hash) AS unique_tokens_today FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT count(*) AS unique_users_today FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COALESCE(sum(api_hits), 0) AS token_api_hits_today FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COALESCE(sum(event_hits), 0) AS event_api_hits_today FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT day::timestamp AS time, metric, value FROM (SELECT day, 'unique_ips' AS metric, count(DISTINCT ip_hash)::bigint AS value FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY day UNION ALL SELECT day, 'unique_tokens' AS metric, count(DISTINCT token_hash)::bigint AS value FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY day UNION ALL SELECT day, 'unique_users' AS metric, count(*)::bigint AS value FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY day) s ORDER BY time, metric

SELECT label, hits FROM (VALUES ('page views', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(page_hits), 0) FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')), ('day api', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(api_hits - event_hits - verify_hits), 0) FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')), ('event detail', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(detail_hits), 0) FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')), ('event search', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(search_hits), 0) FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')), ('nearby', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(nearby_hits), 0) FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')), ('verify', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(verify_hits), 0) FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'))) AS metrics(label, hits) ORDER BY hits DESC
SELECT day::timestamp AS time, endpoint AS metric, hits AS value FROM usage_metrics_api WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY day, endpoint
SELECT endpoint, sum(hits) AS hits FROM usage_metrics_api WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY hits DESC

SELECT left(token_hash, 12) AS token_hash, count(DISTINCT ip_hash) AS ip_count, sum(page_hits) AS page_hits, sum(api_hits) AS api_hits, sum(event_hits) AS event_hits, max(last_seen) AS last_seen FROM usage_metrics_identity WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY token_hash ORDER BY api_hits DESC, page_hits DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT day, endpoint, status, hits, round(total_ms::numeric / NULLIF(hits, 0), 1) AS avg_ms FROM usage_metrics_http WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY day DESC, hits DESC LIMIT 100
